title: La transición a la democracia y el estallido social de 2019
goal: Examine the 1988 'No' plebiscite, the democratic transition, economic growth, and the 2019 social uprising.
grammar: debate sociopolítico chileno, marcadores contraargumentativos y conectores consecutivos

items: Analyze the historic victory of the 'No' plebiscite and return to democracy.
Deploy discourse connectors (si bien, no obstante, de ahí que) in development debates.
Deploy civic protest, plebiscite, and constitutional assembly vocabulary (plebiscito, estallido, cacerolazo, cabildo).
